Bulk Import Bike Sales

Paste rows copied from Excel. Warranty dates are calculated automatically from Sale Date using the Admin warranty period. Columns: Invoice, Sale Date, Sales Executive, Customer, Mobile, Alternate, Address, Model, Color, Registration, Chassis, Engine, Delivery KM, Sale Price. First row may contain headers.

Spare Parts Stock Management

Users may submit new stock rows. Once saved, only Admin can edit or delete stock records. Paste tab-separated data copied from Excel: Part No, Part Name, Model, Quantity, Unit Cost, Selling Price, Location, Reorder Level.

Bulk Reorder Level Update · Admin

Paste two Excel columns: Part No and Reorder Level. Only matching parts are updated; stock quantity is not changed.

Login Screen Picture · Admin

Upload a workshop or motorcycle picture to display behind the login card.

Admin Panel · Warranty Duration

Warranty start date is automatically the motorcycle Sale Date. Warranty end date is calculated using this duration for new and existing sale records.

Admin Panel · Multiple Service Schedules

Create as many service schedules as needed. Every schedule is calculated directly from the motorcycle’s Sale Date and Delivery KM (not from the previous service). Example: First service = 1 month / 1,000 KM; second = 3 months / 3,000 KM.

Schedule NameMonths From Sale DateKM From Delivery KM

Admin Panel · Job Card Dropdown Catalogs

Add as many complaint, inspection and service charge options as needed. Each saved entry appears in its Job Card dropdown. Use Add New to create another option, or Remove to delete one.

Admin Panel · Job Card Logo

Admin Panel · EV Warranty Duration

EV warranty starts from the EV Sale Date. The end date is automatically calculated for new and existing EV sales records.

Admin Panel · EV Multiple Service Schedules
